why does india have so many different festivals

Because India never tried to make everyone the same. 🎆 Your Diwali lamp, the neighbour's Eid biryani, carols at the church down the road, Pongal pots boiling over — different stories, same street. 🪔 The Constitution protects exactly that: each family gets to follow its own faith, or none. Which festival food would you keep if you could keep only one? [CHIPS]Why Pongal is celebrated|What Eid marks|Freedom of religion[/CHIPS]

what actually makes a joke funny

Most explanations agree on two ingredients: the setup builds one expectation, the punchline delivers a different one, and the flip has to feel harmless. Break either and it dies. No surprise, no joke; too close to real hurt, also no joke 😄 It explains why explaining a joke kills it, since you hand over the ending in advance.[QUIZ]Which pair does a joke need?[/QUIZ][CHIPS]Surprise and safety|Surprise and hurt|Rhyme and rhythm[/CHIPS]
what is a maiden over in cricket

Six balls, not a single run off the bat — that is a maiden, and bowlers love them. 🏏 It squeezes the batters, because a frozen scoreboard feels like going backwards. String two together and you will usually see someone try a wild shot and get out. 🔒
[FACT]Six legal deliveries make one over in cricket.[/FACT]

what does the election commission do and why is it independent

Somebody has to referee, and it cannot be one of the players. 🗳️ The Election Commission fixes poll dates, maintains the voter rolls, allots party symbols and enforces a code of conduct on everyone campaigning — including the party currently in power. Its independence is the entire point: if a ruling party could schedule and supervise its own election, the result would prove nothing. ⚖️ [CHIPS]Model code explained|Who appoints them|What EVMs are[/CHIPS]

what is an outlier and should i just delete it

An outlier sits far outside the pack, and deleting one is a decision, not a cleanup 🔍. Sometimes it is a typo — a person 1700 cm tall is a slipped decimal point. Sometimes it is the whole story: one faulty battery in 500 is exactly what a safety test is hunting for. Investigate first, and if you drop it, say so in your report 📋. [FACT]Removing an outlier shifts the mean far more than the median[/FACT] [CHIPS]Spot outliers in data|Mean vs median again|Real data example[/CHIPS]
my dog died three months ago and i still catch myself listening for his nails on the floor

Your ears were trained by years of that sound, and training does not switch off at a funeral. Listening for him is not denial, it is habit outliving the reason for it. It fades slowly and unevenly. If it helps, keep one thing of his somewhere you choose deliberately, rather than meeting his things by accident.[CHIPS]Is that normal|What should I keep|I miss him[/CHIPS]

why do boys get wet dreams

During puberty the testes begin producing sperm and testosterone levels rise. Semen is sometimes released during sleep, and that is what a wet dream is: automatic, with no choice or control involved, and not dirty or a sign of anything. Some people have them often, some never, and both are ordinary. Change the sheets yourself, or ask a parent or doctor anything you are unsure about. 🙂[CHIPS]What is testosterone|Why puberty happens|Something else[/CHIPS]

how does a fridge actually pump heat out of the food

It doesn't make cold — it moves heat. 🧊 A liquid circles a loop and is allowed to boil inside the cold compartment, and boiling soaks up heat from the food. The compressor then squeezes that vapour until it is hotter than your kitchen, so the coils at the back can dump the heat into the room. A fridge is a heat taxi running one way. [CHIPS]How AC works|Why fridges hum[/CHIPS]

what does correlation is not causation mean

Two things moving together does not prove one caused the other. Among children, bigger feet go with better reading — shoe size is not teaching anyone, being older explains both. 👣 That hidden third factor is called a confounder.
